products.name: Vitamin D3 + K2 Drops, 50 ml
products.description:
Vitamin D3 + K2 food supplement drops, 50 ml (about 1,000 drops).

Per daily dose (1 drop): vitamin D3 25 µg (1,000 IU, 500% NRV); vitamin K2 (menaquinone-7, all-trans) 20 µg (27% NRV).

Ingredients: medium-chain triglycerides from coconut oil (96.5%), cholecalciferol (2.5%), menaquinone-7 (1%).

Suggested use: take 1 drop daily. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose.

Food supplements are not a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Keep out of the reach of children. Store closed, dry, cool and protected from light.

Lithuanian label and company details are on the pack. Batch number and best-before date: see bottom of the bottle.
products.short_description: Food supplement drops with vitamin D3 (25 µg / 1,000 IU) and vitamin K2 as MK-7 (20 µg) per daily drop. 50 ml bottle, about 1,000 drops, in coconut-derived MCT oil.
